title: Honour an exclusion exactly
objective: A Customer who says no meat is never shown meat. Measurement established that matching by meaning gets this backwards, so it is a filter and never a phrase.
acceptance_criteria: an excluded food appears ZERO times across the exclusion test set — one occurrence is a failure of the feature, not a ranking miss (SC-005)
a Meal whose relevant field is empty is WITHHELD, not shown (FR-021) — an unknown is a possible yes
an exclusion is never relaxed to fill the screen (FR-020)
a recognised negation marker whose noun does not map returns the unparsed marker, and Kafoo says it did not understand — it NEVER returns results as though no exclusion was asked for
discovery_exclusion_test.sql written and SEEN TO FAIL first
the interface states what was filtered on and NEVER states that a Meal is safe
notes:
grok-4.5 because this is health-adjacent and the model table reserves that row for subtle logic near safety. Measured 2026-08-06: asking for food with no meat returned meat dishes, first correct answer at rank 6, precision@5 of 0.00. A Customer excluding a food is usually doing so for dietary, religious or health reasons, so serving them the opposite is a betrayal rather than a poor result. The sharp edge is that meals.allergens is frequently an AI estimate carrying nutrition_source — hence 'states what it filtered on, never that a Meal is safe'. Touches search_meals, which WP-013 created; serialised behind it by dependency.
